Title: Stand-in Frog's Weaponry
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Frogs_Weaponry folder name and
the shape its port reads on the stand-in Tier 1 (a spinning gun that slows
and deploys, a launcher that slows its holder, their preferences and ammo
types), so the listed port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and
holds none of its files, and its guns, names and numbers are its own.
